motivating_result.posthoc_status: The same horns_left and fern target scores have already been inspected. This follow-up is therefore a registered posthoc diagnostic and not an independent target-blind validation.

purpose: Test whether preserving official SAM3 trial consensus as a parameter-free reliability-conditioned soft source observation avoids the union-like failure of Li binarization.

fixed_phase1_inputs.allowed_phase1_tensor: aggregate_probability equal to the arithmetic mean q of the ten frozen official SAM3 binary masks

mathematical_operator.domain: q is finite and lies in [0,1] at every native 1008x756 source pixel
mathematical_operator.binary_entropy_nats: H2(q) = -q ln(q) - (1-q) ln(1-q), with 0 ln(0) defined as 0
scribble_authority_order: compute s(q) from the frozen aggregate q
overwrite every raw official positive scribble pixel to exactly 1
overwrite every raw official negative scribble pixel to exactly 0
mathematical_operator.negative_observation: the raw official negative scribble remains a separate exact negative channel
mathematical_operator.numeric_rule: compute entropy and reliability in float64, clamp only roundoff to [0,1], then freeze q, c(q), and s(q) as contiguous float32 tensors

exact_adjoint.hard_positive_anchor: raw positive exclusive primitive rows only
exact_adjoint.hard_negative_anchor: raw negative exclusive primitive rows only

fixed_support.relation: the same query-independent C-RADIO DINO signed multiplicative hash256
fixed_support.classifier: balanced LogisticRegression C=0.01, signed_nonzero rows, sample weighted by reference_weight

authority_boundary.source_reference_rgb: already consumed only by the frozen phase1 artifact

execution_order.phase_prelabel: Freeze and reload both selectors in order horns_left then fern; neither target scorer may start until both selector receipts exist and pass hash validation.
execution_order.phase_score: After the cross-scene hard boundary, score horns_left then fern with the unchanged frozen exact target readout.

gate.pass: follow-up macro improves by at least 0.03, at least one sentinel improves, and neither sentinel regresses by more than 0.03

runtime.thermal_policy: 300W physical limit, launch 79C, soft pause 82C, resume 78C, hard abort 85C, no peer-GPU coupling
